ledger.claim: The driver's no-show termination rate trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on both limbs at the same time: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is exactly 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Both limbs are required and both are met, so compensation must be WITHHELD and the case escalated under POL-NS-09, and the escalation packet must carry the direction POL-NS-07 writes into it - that the reviewer refund this rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full. On these figures the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved.

The pattern the rider asked to have reviewed is on the driver's side of the record, not the rider's. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d)'s rider-abuse limb does not fire, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c)'s same-pair repeat-dispute limb does not fire either. The only abuse indicator anywhere in this bundle sits on the driver's profile, and it is that indicator - not anything the rider did - that drives the escalation.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and replaces the money: the disputed SGD 4.00 is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded while the review is pending, so the rider is not made to carry the charge in the meantime. Where fare_breakdown.payment_status is PENDING, a NO_ACTION outcome would leave that charge standing against the filing rider; holding it is the outcome on this record that does not leave the rider out of pocket, and the refund direction in the POL-NS-07 packet is the substantive relief the rider is asking for.

The driver has no advisory-based route by which to extend or excuse his waiting clock. EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING with a null payload, and POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory is present and populated and carries KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT over the pickup road. The driver's dwell case therefore rests on the single continuous 330-second run recorded in the trace, 30 seconds over the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, and on nothing else.

Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied: the trip record for TRP-09108 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20+08:00 at the PLQ 3 pickup bay, so the anchor condition for a chargeable no-show fee is present on the record.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied and the POL-NS-02 proximity test is passed: the driver's trace contains 34 fixes whose mean, minimum and maximum distance from the pickup pin are each 24.01 m, so every fix sits well inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 09:30:00 precedes the 'arrived' event at 09:30:20. All 34 fixes are qualifying fixes (34 of 34 under the 25 m accuracy filter), so this is not a sparse-trace case.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied: measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 09:30:00 (not from the 'arrived' tap) to the cancellation at 09:35:30, the driver held position for a continuous 330 seconds, exceeding the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE by 30 seconds - the derived shortfall is -30.0 s - over a single uninterrupted run of 34 fixes at a recorded speed of 0.0 kph.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied: the trip record shows no boarding event and records the trip terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises - at the very moment the required 300-second dwell elapsed.

POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the 09:30:20 arrival marker the driver was stationary 24.01 m from the pin with a recorded ground speed of 0.0 kph, so he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at 15 kph or above, and the arrival marker is not a false one. There is also no clock-skew problem to weigh: the first GPS fix at 09:30:00 and the arrived event at 09:30:20 are 20 seconds apart, inside the 90-second POL-NS-08(a) tolerance.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds only two messages - a system 'Your driver has arrived' notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay.' - and no locating or coordinating message from the rider at all, so limb (a) fails at the first hurdle. Independently, the rider's own track shows 0 qualifying fixes and a mean distance of 519.4 m from the pin, far outside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, so limb (c) is not merely undecidable but affirmatively failed on this record.

POL-NS-06 does not apply because there is no shortfall to excuse: the single in-geofence interval ran the full 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum, so no accumulation across separate intervals is required, no traffic advisory is needed, and the MISSING advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09108-01 (null payload, weight 0.0) is simply not engaged - I do not assert limb (i) against it.

POL-NS-03 does not apply: that clause decides a driver who held position outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas this driver held position 24.01 m from the pin, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius, so the wrong-entrance route to a refund is not open on these facts and the 400 m ceiling is never reached.

The amount charged is internally correct: the chargeable fee is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - a tie resolved at SGD 4.00 - which reconciles exactly with the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in fare_breakdown, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect for the rider to exploit and fare_breakdown is not impaired on that limb.

On a verified rider no-show POL-NS-07 computes the driver's compensation at 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, that is SGD 3.20, but I do not put that forward as an automatic payout, because the clause's anti-farming branch is engaged on the face of driver_profile: no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (4 or more) and 7 divided by completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb, so both limbs are met and compensation is withheld with the case routed to escalation under POL-NS-09(d). Those trailing-30-day figures are not disputed; the consequence is that the fee is held rather than refunded while a reviewer looks at it, and the driver's position is that the underlying charge stands on the merits of POL-NS-01.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: The driver's baseline no-show case is made out on the merits. EV-TRIP-09108 shows an arrived event at 09:30:20; EV-GPS-09108 places the driver 24.01 m from the PLQ pin, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, with 34 qualifying fixes; the dwell from the first in-geofence fix at 09:30:00 to the 09:35:30 cancellation is 330 seconds, over the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum; and the trip was terminated by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-05 is not triggered: the driver was stationary at 0.0 kph and 24.01 m from the pin, so the arrival marker is not false. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the POL-NS-02 radius. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to excuse, and the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 (weight 0.0) is not engaged. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails because the chat log contains no rider locating or coordinating message; I note that the rider track has 0 qualifying fixes, so limb (c) would be undecidable/neutral rather than affirmatively failed, but the clause does not apply without limb (a). The SGD 4.00 fare line is correct as the greater/tie of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee. However, POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (4 or more) and 7 / 70 completed trips = 0.10, above 0.08. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal: no monetary ruling issues, and the SGD 4.00 fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The escalation packet must direct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 fee in full under POL-NS-07, recorded as a referral. The rider's pattern-review request is answered by the driver-profile anti-farming trigger; the rider's no-show dispute count and same-pair dispute count are 0, so no rider-abuse escalation limb fires. Confidence is 1.0 because the deciding facts come from platform telemetry with no disclosed impairment; the missing advisory is weight 0.0 but does not carry the escalation fact.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-07: Direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full; the SGD 4.00 fee is held pending review.
